title: Mogura no Uta
titleNative: 土竜の唄
synopsis: Tanibukuro city's Officer Kikukawa Reiji is the problem child of the police force. He doesn't always follow protocol and he enforces justice through his own personal morals. But it was that exact unwavering sense of righteousness that convinced the chief of police that Reiji was a perfect fit for a top secret undercover mission. He is given the task of infiltrating the Sukiya organization, the biggest and most dangerous mafia group of the Kanto region, and find solid evidence to arrest its leader Todoroki Shuho. But being accepted and trusted in the mafia means Reiji has to do unthinkable things and put himself in dangerous situations where one little slip and his life would be over. (Source: MangaHelpers)

synopsis: Hokkaido is an island of extreme cold. There, scientists and members of the Japanese self-defence force investigate a mysterious animal attack, and discover a frozen mummy in a cave. When they return from the cave, one of the investigators undergoes a strange metamorphosis – a new organism emerges from the destruction of the human body. Mankind has encountered the "Higher Tribe" and falls into despair. (Source: LINE Manga, translated)

title: Manga Lover
titleNative: マンガラバー
synopsis: While conducting research in the back alleys of the Shinjuku Toho Building (To-yoko), third-year manga editor Yanai hears the voice of Misumi, who wants to show him her manga. Having previously focused solely on producing successful works, Yanai finds himself captivated by Misumi's rough drafts, and decides to guide her to a successful serialization. However, Misumi has neither home nor money... This is the story of a young creator and editor rising through the ranks, inspiring the world through their manga. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: NINE PEAKS
titleNative: NINE PEAKS
synopsis: Gaku Mashio was a first-year high school student who lived with his father. He lost his father in a sudden accident, just as he got suspended from school after getting into a fight. On the night of his father's wake, Gaku went fishing on the shore in memory of his father, but he fell into the sea and was returned 22 years into the past. Gaku's father, Harumi, who was the same age as Gaku at that time, saved him from the water. Harumi's parents (Gaku's grandparents) took a liking to Gaku, and accepted him into their family under the name Gaku Miyagi. His grandparents even encouraged him to go to Seiha High School, same as his father. Twenty-two years ago, the town of Kurei was full of delinquents. Now Gaku and his father will fight their way to the top of the town! (Source: Shonen Champion, translated)

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
titleRomaji: Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta!
titleNative: 野生のラスボスが現れた！
synopsis: Lufas Maphaahl rules the land of Mizgarz with an iron fist. Mankind stands no chance of prevailing against the most powerful being in the world and her army of loyal minions—until a band of heroes bests her in an epic battle, sealing her soul away for all eternity. But this is just another day in Exgate Online. Lufas is a player's avatar and a legend among fans. She even outshines the official last boss, the Devil King. So it's no big deal to the boy behind Lufas when he logs off after his epic defeat—thankfully, it won't really be eternity until he can play again. But he's met by a strange offer, and when he accepts, he's sucked into the game world and awakens...in Lufas's body! Two hundred years have passed since Lufas's defeat, and Mizgarz now lives under the shadow of the Devil King. How will our hero fix his mess? And can he save the world from the one being he never subordinated: the last boss? (Source: J-Novel Club)
